notes: Fix (1): both exe sides normalized via path.win32.normalize().toLowerCase(); matching requires the exact '--user-data-dir='+PROFILE_DIR element in args (no substring path match); owned.pid asserted in-wrapper and again post-launch; chrome-process.json now records redacted browserArgs (values containing OUT redacted) and env key names only; windowsHide retained.

Fix (2): msgState reads getComputedStyle(el).color and compares to 'rgb(204, 34, 34)' instead of the nonexistent 'error' class; step assertions now record messageErrorShown as true or false depending on outcome.

Fix (3): importFile installs a scoped MutationObserver promise via page.evaluate before fc.setFiles, awaits it only after setFiles, resolves on nonempty #msg text (success or error), bounded 12s timer disconnects and resolves null; no state injection, no app monkeypatching, no message clearing, no globals; chooser click retained.

Fix (4): reset throws when prior errors exist (after logging history); expected===null requires visible '#map .empty' (assertions.emptyVisible + pass gating); t.tree exceptions inside step are rethrown prefixed 'REFERENCE_FAILURE' so catch classifies them as REFERENCE_FAILURE.

Fix (5): catch pushes rec only if !steps.includes(rec); actionCount computed via countLines() - before and recorded before snap in all paths; snap signature gains bestEffort flag — pass path lets screenshot failures propagate, catch path uses best-effort with reason preserved.

Fix (6): ownedContext module-level tracks ctx (set immediately after launch, before the pid assertion that can throw); exported emergencyClose performs scoped ctx.close with pages before/after and owned exit evidence written to emergency-close.json; t.close now records pagesAfterClose and exact owned child pid/exitedAt/exitCode, rethrows close errors, no broad process termination.
Reference UI methodology retained; no H tests added.
